description: Security Hub is not subscribed in the observed AWS Region
rationale: An AWS Security Hub DescribeHub call explicitly returned ResourceNotFoundException. A missing subscription in the observed Region is a configuration observation; API denials and malformed responses must remain UNKNOWN. This does not prove organizational aggregation or control effectiveness.
remediation: Determine whether AWS Security Hub CSPM is required in the Region, enable it and review applicable standards where appropriate. Verify delegated administration, findings ingestion and aggregation separately.
